_doc: Registries that carried no traceable derivation when the fence landed (GHI #1066). SHRINK-ONLY: this list may lose entries and never gain one. An entry leaves by the registry recording its authority -- a provenance field citing a docs/**.md path, an ADR, a GHI or an operator ruling, or a `derivation` field on its data/config_registry.json entry for a bare array that cannot carry one. Presence here is NOT a judgement that the value is wrong; it records that no reader can tell a deliberate choice from an inherited accident. Measured by docs/governance/config-derivation-2026-09-20-evidence/census.py.
